Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

  
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.

existing_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Customer Quality Manager to join our team in Charleston, South Carolina. This is an on-site position based in Charleston, South Carolina. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager of Customer Quality serves as the primary quality liaison between Elevate Aircraft Seating's manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of quality issues, and alignment with customer and regulatory requirements. This highly visible, customer-facing position is responsible for leading defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action coordination while driving quality improvements back into manufacturing operations to prevent recurring issues and strengthen product conformity. The Senior Manager of Customer Quality partners cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and customer stakeholders to drive accountability, proactively address quality concerns, and strengthen customer relationships. This position also provides executive leadership with data-driven reporting on quality performance, emerging risks, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to support informed decision-making and operational excellence.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential*

**Customer Quality Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Elevate manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring alignment on quality concerns, operational priorities, and resolution activities.
* Lead customer-facing quality discussions, providing technically accurate information, objective evidence, and clear communication regarding product conformity, nonconformances, and corrective actions.
* Establish and maintain structured communication cadences with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely escalation, consistent messaging, and accountability for quality-related issues.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, effective problem-solving, and timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Defect Management & Technical Quality Assurance**

* Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of product defects and nonconformances, identifying root causes, points of origin, and appropriate corrective actions across manufacturing, receiving inspection, and final assembly operations.
* Evaluate reported nonconformances against applicable Letters of Conformance (LOCs), approved craftsmanship documentation, engineering specifications, and customer requirements to ensure accurate defect classification and resolution.
* Partner with Boeing and internal Quality and Engineering teams on corrective action investigations, providing technical analysis, objective evidence, and recommendations to support effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of aircraft interior products, functionality, design requirements, and installation processes to effectively evaluate quality concerns and communicate technical findings.
* Coordinate appropriate inspection and acceptance testing support during aircraft installation activities, including verification of electrical connections, mechanical functionality, and applicable acceptance test procedures (ATP).

**Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure customer-facing quality activities align with applicable FAA/EASA regulations, AS9100 standards, customer specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Maintain accurate, traceable quality documentation and defect records through established systems, including SharePoint, ensuring appropriate stakeholders have access to current information and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the communication and implementation of applicable service bulletins, engineering changes, and product effectivity requirements across manufacturing locations, OSS, Boeing, and customers.
* Support customer quality reviews, audits, and regulatory compliance activities by providing technical documentation, investigation findings, and corrective action evidence.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive cross-functional corrective and preventive action initiatives to address customer quality concerns, eliminate recurring defects, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
* Translate customer quality feedback, defect trends, and investigation findings into actionable improvement opportunities for manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Apply root cause analysis, statistical methods, and structured problem-solving techniques to validate defect origins, assess corrective action effectiveness, and support sustainable improvements.
* Identify emerging quality risks and recurring issues, proactively escalating concerns and coordinating mitigation activities to minimize customer impact and prevent recurrence.

**Executive Reporting & Cross-Functional Quality Performance**

* Develop and present quality performance reports, defect trends, corrective action status, and emerging risks to executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support operational decision-making.
* Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer defects, resolution timelines, recurring issues, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and OSS teams to drive accountability, coordinate issue resolution, and ensure timely implementation of quality improvements across affected operations.
* Monitor customer quality deliverables, open issues, and corrective action commitments to ensure alignment with program milestones, customer expectations, and organizational quality objectives.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, or quality management within aerospace manufacturing or a related highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and present quality performance metrics, defect trends, corrective action status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, and translating customer quality concerns into sustainable manufacturing improvements.
* Extensive background in defect investigations, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across manufacturing and customer operations.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a primary quality interface with customers, including managing complex quality concerns, presenting technical findings, and driving issue resolution.
* Minimum of 5 years working with aerospace quality standards, FAA/EASA regulatory requirements, product conformity, and applicable customer quality requirements.

**Skills:**

* Strong technical understanding of aircraft interior products, manufacturing processes, installation requirements, and quality documentation, including Letters of Conformance (LOCs) and approved craftsmanship standards.
* Advanced proficiency in nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and evidence-based defect investigation and resolution.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings, resolve customer concerns, and influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quality data, identify trends, evaluate risks, and present actionable recommendations to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, establish structured communication processes, drive accountability, and implement sustainable quality improvements without direct supervisory authority.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Formal training or practical experience conducting customer, regulatory, or third-party quality audits within the aerospace industry.
* Working knowledge of advanced quality methodologies, including APQP, FMEA, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and AS9145 requirements.

existing_roles.description:
Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we're building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We're not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here.

LeoLabs is seeking a Head of Manufacturing to lead the next phase of production scaling of our radar systems. This leader will own the manufacturing strategy, industrialization roadmap, quality management, facility scaling, and cross-functional execution required to increase production capacity beyond 10x. This role may be leveled as Senior Director or Vice President level based on the successful candidate’s experience, leadership scope and demonstrated ability to own the function. The role with report directly to the SVP, Radars. This role is a full-time, in-person position based at our headquarters in Menlo Park, CA. Regular domestic travel is expected.

The Head of Manufacturing will turn LeoLabs’ advanced radar designs from low/medium-rate initial production into repeatable, scalable, high-rate production systems. You will collaborate with and leverage support from Product, Supply Chain, Radar Systems and Hardware Engineering, Program Management, Finance and Accounting, and executive leadership to build the manufacturing capacity that enables LeoLabs to deploy radar systems more reliably and at greater scale for the U.S. Government, allies, and commercial customers.

The preferred candidate has done this before – they are a leader who has built and sustained a manufacturing system, rather than someone who has only managed an existing operation. This candidate is a hands-on manufacturing executive or emerging executive from a high-performance production environment such as aerospace, defense technology, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. They have scaled production systems from the ground up, built functional teams, improved quality, stood up facilities or production lines, and operated with urgency in environments where reliability, repeatability, and mission success matter.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Strategy & Scale

* Own LeoLabs’ high-rate manufacturing and industrialization strategy for radar systems, subsystems, and associated high-reliability hardware across manufacturing, assembly, integration, and test operations.
* Build and scale a production system and team capable of supporting 10x growth in radar production over the next 2 years while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, integration, and deployment readiness.
* Define the operating model across internal manufacturing, external suppliers, contract manufacturing, and integration partners.
* Own the high-rate production footprint plan including facility needs, equipment, tooling, staffing, and capital investment.
* Stand up scalable production lines, work cells, fixtures, test stations, documentation, and acceptance processes for radar hardware, RF systems, electronics, electromechanical assemblies, power systems, compute infrastructure, and system-level integration.
* Establish the scaled manufacturing steady state including production planning, throughput management, capacity planning, cost analysis, quality, and delivery execution.

Industrialization

* Own the transition from engineering builds to production-ready designs.
* Establish and mature release and readiness gates, first-article processes, and build documentation.
* Partner with Radar Systems and Hardware Engineering teams to industrialize new radar designs, ensuring manufacturability, testability, serviceability, configuration control, and production readiness.
* Partner with engineering NPI manufacturing team to improve manufacturability, DfX, and cost reduction opportunities.
* Ensure new radar products have validated build plans, test procedures, tooling, factory acceptance testing criteria, and supplier plans before production ramp.
* Create a functioning feedback system from manufacturing and sustainment back into product and engineering.

Quality, Reliability & Production

* Build and mature the quality management system required for high-reliability radar systems serving mission-critical customers.
* Establish clear standards for configuration control, traceability, inspection, nonconformance management, corrective action, supplier quality, and production acceptance.
* Drive measurable improvements in yield, first-pass quality, rework, scrap, field defects, and schedule performance.
* Build strong review mechanisms for failures, escapes, production risks, and systemic issues.
* Partner with Technical Program Management to align production readiness and execution with program, contract, customer, and deployment commitments
* Partner with Supply Chain on supplier readiness, long-lead planning, cost reduction, and risk mitigation.
* Partner with the Radar Operations Center and Global Infrastructure to turn field performance and maintenance data into product and process improvements to increase performance, reduce operational impacts, and decrease maintenance costs.
* Develop manufacturing KPIs and high-level dashboards for throughput, schedule metrics, yield, labor tracking, cost, quality, rework, scrap, supplier performance, and field reliability.

Team Leadership

* Establish and lead the LeoLabs Production System, creating a common operating model for safety, quality, delivery, cost and people. Implement tiered daily management, visual controls, standard work, structured problem solving, leader standard work, production flow, capacity management and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, develop, and lead a world-class manufacturing organization including manufacturing operations, production, test operations, quality, facilities, and related functions.
* Set clear ownership and metrics across the manufacturing organization.
* Build a culture of execution, urgency, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

* 15+ years of experience in manufacturing, production operations, industrialization, factory operations, manufacturing engineering, or related operational leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and leading a mature Lean manufacturing or production operating system, such as the Toyota Production System, including standard work, visual management, daily accountability, structured problem solving, flow, built-in quality, waste reduction and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated experience scaling production capacity, standing up production lines or facilities, and improving throughput, quality, cost, and delivery performance.
* Experience manufacturing complex, high-reliability hardware in industries such as aerospace, defense, automotive, advanced electronics, robotics, industrial automation, energy systems, RF systems, communications, space systems, or mission-critical infrastructure.
* Experience with quality management systems and standards such as AS9100, ISO 9001, IPC standards, ESD controls, supplier quality, first-article inspection
* Strong technical fluency with hardware product development, NPI, configuration control, test operations, production readiness, and root-cause corrective action.
* Excellent communication, leadership, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Eligibility to obtain and maintain required U.S. security clearances, as applicable to this role.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, industrial engineering, supply chain, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

* Formal training or demonstrated practitioner experience in Toyota Production System, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Lean Six Sigma or an equivalent operating system. Black Belt, Master Black Belt, TPS practitioner/trainer or comparable credentials preferred.
* Experience developing greenfield or brownfield production facilities, production lines, integration sites, or manufacturing cells.
* Experience with radar, RF systems, antennas, communications systems, sensors, satellites, ground systems, aerospace systems, or other complex electromechanical products.
* Experience supporting Department of War, Space Force, NASA, or allied government customers.
* Experience working with classified, export-controlled, ITAR/EAR-controlled, or otherwise sensitive hardware programs.
* Master’s degree in engineering, operations, business administration, manufacturing, supply chain, or a related discipline.

Compensation

This position is benchmarked to San Francisco Bay Area with a base salary range of $225,000 - $248,000, plus bonus, equity, and benefits.

Compensation Note: The salary range for this position is benchmarked based on the designated primary work location for the role. Final compensation may vary depending on the selected candidate’s work location, applicable market data, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Perks and Benefits

* Global workforce: flexible remote/hybrid opportunities
* Work on complex, meaningful missions with real-world impact
* Unlimited paid time off for most roles
* Competitive salary and equity packages
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Access to the forefront of commercial space operations and defense innovation

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International

Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the

U.S. Department of State. More information regarding ITAR can be found at DDTC's website.

Pay: $225,000.00 - $248,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan

The Director Continuous Improvement will establish and mature the enterprise continuous improvement capability, governance framework, and operating model. The Director will enable business divisions to identify, prioritize, implement, and sustain improvements that strengthen efficiency, quality, associate experience, customer experience, and business outcomes.

In partnership with senior executives, functional leaders, and cross-functional teams, the Director will challenge the status quo, redesign workflows, reduce complexity, and build a culture of continuous improvement across the organization. This leader will serve as the head of the Continuous Improvement Center of Excellence (COE), setting enterprise methodology, governance, capability-development, coaching, and portfolio-oversight standards. The Director will partner with business leaders to embed ownership and execution within divisions while maintaining enterprise consistency, transparency, and alignment.

The internal deadline to apply is 11/13/2026. External applications will be accepted on a rolling basis while the position remains open.

**What you will do:**

* Establish and lead the enterprise Continuous Improvement Center of Excellence (COE).
* Develop and maintain the enterprise continuous improvement methodology, standards, tools, templates, and governance framework.
* Lead, coach, and develop direct reports to manage performance and build future leadership capacity.
* Create a culture of accountability, engagement, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* Define and maintain enterprise standards for improvement opportunity identification, prioritization, measurement, and sustainment.
* Assess organizational continuous improvement maturity and develop capability-building roadmaps.
* Facilitate a Community of Practice to share best practices, lessons learned, tools, and success stories across divisions.

* Provide leadership, coaching, standards, and oversight for the evaluation of current business processes, workflows, handoffs, controls, and decision points to identify inefficiencies, duplication, bottlenecks, risk, and opportunities for improvement.

existing_roles.description:
Innovation, craftsmanship, and a customer-first mindset fuel our growth at Alloy Precision Technologies. Step into a role where your leadership elevates safety, quality, delivery, and cost—every day.

**A day in the role**
---------------------

Your morning begins with cross-functional huddles, aligning production, supply chain, maintenance, and planning on the day’s priorities. You review dashboards that track delivery promises, schedule adherence, inventory health, and quality metrics. Midday finds you on the floor diagnosing a throughput constraint, coaching leaders, and reinforcing safe work practices. In the afternoon, you refine the operating rhythm: standard work, real-time schedule visibility, and continuous improvement plans. You close the day mentoring team members and shaping the next wave of operational objectives that sharpen customer service and profitability.

**What you will lead**
----------------------

* End-to-end oversight of manufacturing operations, including production, supply chain, maintenance, production planning, and warehouse activities.
* Deployment of robust quality and efficiency standards that achieve performance targets and elevate product excellence.
* Ownership of safety leadership and environmental stewardship across all operations.
* Proactive resolution of production issues—investigating, analyzing, troubleshooting, and driving timely recovery plans.
* Design and implementation of on-time performance tracking to keep schedules visible and reliable, ensuring strong margins, responsive service, and consistent quality.
* Regular reporting on operational health, highlighting opportunities, risks, and results.
* Implementation of lean manufacturing and other flow/business process systems to reduce cost, improve quality, and increase profitability.
* Stronger cross-functional communication and collaboration with corporate teams and adjacent functions.
* Team building through mentoring, motivation, and effective delegation—empowering leaders to deliver results.
* Annual operating plans and programs that guide manufacturing, service, and distribution performance.
* Execution that meets or exceeds customer commitments and complies with AS9100 and all applicable regulations.
* Domestic and international travel as needed to support operations and customers.
* Additional assignments as directed by the President and Chief Executive Officer.

**Supervisory scope**
---------------------

* Direct supervision of group leaders, supply chain, and production planning; scope may evolve as the organization grows.
* Full-cycle people leadership aligned with APT policies and applicable laws: recruiting, hiring, onboarding, training, work assignment, performance evaluation, recognition, corrective action, issue resolution, and career development.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years of manufacturing leadership experience; background in precision welding (TIG, laser, brazing, soldering), CNC/manual machining, and light assembly is advantageous.
* Strong digital fluency: Microsoft Office; experience with databases/ERP (e.g., Visual Manufacturing) and developing labor standards for cost structures is a plus.
* High energy, results orientation, confidence, and strong interpersonal influence; able to build rapport at all levels.
* Strategic, proactive, and persistent; comfortable juggling multiple projects and customers in a fast-paced setting.
* Adaptable and resilient within a dynamic, evolving culture; passionate about excellence and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of lean manufacturing required; Six Sigma experience is a plus.

existing_roles.title: Sourcing Director: NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers
existing_roles.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

The Director, NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers leads strategic execution across new product introduction, acquired-business integration, and supplier/manufacturing transfer initiatives. This senior leader is accountable for ensuring products, processes, supply chains, and teams transition successfully from development, acquisition, or incumbent suppliers into stable, compliant, scalable operations.  
The role requires strong business judgment, deep supply-base knowledge, technical fluency, and the ability to lead complex programs in a regulated medical-device environment. The Director partners closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, R&D, Finance, Manufacturing Engineering, and leadership to deliver continuity of supply, cost competitiveness, product quality, and growth objectives.  
  
Reports to: Senior Director Procurement (Cost Center - M&A)  
Direct reports: Integration Program leaders, supplier-transfer leaders, NPI project managers, supplier development personnel

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

1. NPI Execution and Operational Readiness  

* Lead the end-to-end operational execution of New Product Introduction programs, from design-transfer planning through commercialization and sustained production.
* Establish integrated NPI execution plans & Ensure alignment between product development timelines and operational deliverables, including design transfer, process characterization, validation, supplier readiness, and product availability.
* Drive structured phase-gate governance with external suppliers , program reviews, escalation mechanisms, and executive decision-making for high-priority launches.

  
2. M&A Operations Integration  

* Serve as the Procurement lead for M&A integrations.
* Executes the integration for acquired companies for mitigation of supply-chain risk, supplier dependencies, tier-II management, partners with SQ team for quality-system maturity.
* Define and lead integration roadmaps for acquired businesses, including supplier onboarding, quality-system alignment, tier-II management and smooth transition to Contract manufacturing partner(s)
* Lead Procurement part of integration governance, ensuring milestones, decisions, risks, and accountabilities are visible and managed at the appropriate leadership level.

  
3. Supplier Transfer and Supply-Base Optimization  

* Lead complex supplier-transfer programs, including strategic sourcing transitions, supplier exits, dual-source strategies, vertical-integration initiatives, and manufacturing footprint changes.
* Develop transfer strategies that balance continuity of supply, quality, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, cost, capacity, and timing.
* Ensure supplier transfers are executed in accordance with applicable quality-system requirements, change-control processes, validation requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Direct supplier selection, qualification, technical transfer, process validation, first-article activities, production ramp-up, and supplier performance monitoring.

  
4. People Leadership and Organizational Capability  

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of program, technical, supply-chain, and supplier-management professionals.
* Set clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for direct reports.
* Build succession capability and strengthen organizational depth in NPI execution, technical operations, supplier transfer, and integration management.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration among teams with potentially competing objectives, timelines, and priorities.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

Leadership  

* Builds high-performing teams and develops future leaders.
* Establishes clarity, accountability, and disciplined execution
* Leads through ambiguity, organizational change, and competing business priorities.

Business Acumen  

* Connects technical and operational decisions to financial, customer, and enterprise outcomes.
* Evaluates strategic tradeoffs with an enterprise-wide perspective.
* Identifies opportunities for value creation, risk reduction, and sustainable growth.

Technical and Procurement Expertise  

* Understands manufacturing processes, product industrialization, supplier capabilities, process controls, validation, and quality-system expectations.
* Demonstrates strong command of supply-base dynamics, supplier economics, sourcing strategy, and operational risk.
* Can challenge technical assumptions constructively and facilitate fact-based decisions.

Program Execution  

* Drives complex initiatives from strategy through implementation and stabilization.
* Uses effective governance, metrics, risk management, and escalation practices.
* Maintains focus on customer service, quality, compliance, delivery, and financial results.

Influence and Collaboration  

* Builds credibility with senior leaders, technical experts, plant leadership, suppliers, and all other stakeholders.
* Resolves conflict constructively and aligns diverse stakeholders behind common objectives.
* Communicates complex issues in a concise, actionable manner.

**Your Background**
-------------------

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, or a related technical discipline.
* Approximately 20 years of progressive experience in medical devices, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, or another highly regulated industry.
* Hands on experience & leadership experience in one or more of the following areas:
* New Product Introduction and product industrialization
* Strategic Sourcing and Supplier Management
* Supplier Transfers or Manufacturing Transfers
* Mergers, Acquisitions, and Business Integration
* Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations Program Management
* Proven people-management experience, including leading managers and technical professionals in a matrixed global environment.
* Strong knowledge of supplier qualification, supplier development, capacity planning, quality agreements, process validation, and manufacturing transfer principles.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate and manage supply-base risk, including sole-source exposure, capacity constraints, supplier quality issues, and business-continuity risks.
* Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, cost analysis, budget ownership, and value-capture management.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting medical-device product launches and design-transfer activities.
* Experience integrating acquired companies, product portfolios, manufacturing sites, or supplier networks.
* Familiarity with regulated quality systems and supplier-control expectations.
* Experience with lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, operational excellence, or structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Experience leading global suppliers and geographically distributed teams.
* Professional certifications in program management, supply chain, quality, or lean methodologies are desirable.

**Expected Compensation Data**
------------------------------

$166,500.00 - $208,300.00

protected_roles.title: Vice President, Manufacturing
protected_roles.description:
**ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY SYSTEMS COMPANY**

**Vice President, Manufacturing**

**Function:**

Operations & Manufacturing

**Reports To:**

Chief Operating Officer

**Location:**

Gilbert, AZ – On-site

**Clearance:**

Secret (or eligible)

**ABOUT ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY SYSTEMS COMPANY**

Advanced Technology Systems Company designs and builds mission-critical systems that protect U.S. warfighters, national infrastructure, and allied partners. Our solutions are fielded by the Department of War (DOW) and the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), as well as the most demanding military end users in the world, where performance, quality, and on-time delivery are non-negotiable. As our backlog of multi-million-dollar government programs grows, we are investing in the people, automation, and facilities needed to deliver at scale.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking a proven Vice President of Manufacturing to lead end-to-end manufacturing and materials operations across our government and defense program portfolio. This executive will provide strategic and operational leadership for production, manufacturing engineering, quality, procurement, and material-flow functions—including kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom operations—and oversee the manufacturing planning and procurement systems that enable execution. The role owns plant operations, factory overhead, process automation, throughput, process controls, and facilities, turning contract commitments into high-quality hardware delivered on schedule and within cost. This is a hands-on executive role for a leader who has scaled defense production and integrated manufacturing, quality, and supply functions to support sustained growth. You will sit on the senior operations leadership team and have a direct impact on program margins, customer confidence, and the company’s growth.

**ORGANIZATIONAL SCOPE**

The position is intended to provide executive-level oversight of the integrated functions and capabilities required to plan, source, build, inspect, and deliver products. Functions within the role’s organizational scope are expected to include hourly assembly and test personnel; manufacturing engineering; quality; procurement; and materials operations, including kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom management. The role also provides functional ownership and governance of the manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems (including Costpoint MRP and Purchasing), in coordination with IT and Finance as appropriate.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Program Production Execution**

* **Contract delivery: Own manufacturing execution for multi-million-dollar DOW and government contracts, meeting cost, schedule, and quality requirements from LRIP through full-rate production.**
* Integrated planning: Lead integrated production and materials planning with Program Management, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain; align master production schedules, procurement plans, material availability, capacity plans, and Earned Value (EVMS) reporting.
* **Production readiness:** Lead design-for-manufacturability reviews, PRRs, and transition-to-production activities for new multi-million dollar programs.

**Plant Operations & Financial Performance**

* **Factory leadership:** Lead plant managers, production supervisors, manufacturing engineers, and hourly workforce across shifts; build a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* **Cost ownership:** Manage the manufacturing budget, labor, and factory overhead; drive cost-reduction initiatives that protect program margin and improve competitiveness on future bids.
* **Throughput:** Set and deliver targets for yield, cycle time, OEE, first-pass yield, and on-time delivery; remove bottlenecks and balance lines.

**Materials, Procurement & Quality**

**Procurement leadership:** Provide strategic oversight of procurement, supplier performance, sourcing, and material availability; align purchasing priorities with production schedules, program requirements, and cost objectives.

**Materials flow:** Oversee kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom operations to ensure accurate inventory control, timely material delivery to production, and effective control of work in process.

**Quality leadership:** Provide leadership and accountability for manufacturing quality, corrective and preventive action, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement; ensure quality is integrated into production planning and execution.

**Planning systems:** Own the business processes and functional requirements for manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems, including Costpoint MRP and Purchasing; drive data integrity, effective system utilization, and coordination with IT and Finance.

**Automation & Process Controls**

* **Automation strategy:** Define and execute a multi-year automation roadmap, including robotics, automated test, and MES/ERP integration, with clear ROI.
* Quality & process discipline: Lead the quality function and establish statistical process control, configuration management, corrective action, and documentation compliant with AS9100, ITAR, DFARS, and customer quality clauses.
* **Lean & Six Sigma:** Deploy Lean manufacturing and Six Sigma practices to reduce variation, scrap, rework, and cost of poor quality.

**Facilities Management**

* **Facilities & capital:** Oversee facilities, maintenance, EHS, and secure-area requirements; lead capital planning, plant layout, and expansion projects to support backlog growth.
* **Compliance & audits:** Serve as the senior manufacturing representative for DCMA, customer, and third-party audits and source inspections.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership, including 7+ years at the director or VP level running plant operations for complex electromechanical, electronic, or aerospace hardware.
* Demonstrated record of scaling and automating production on large U.S. defense or military contracts, from low-rate initial production to full-rate output.
* Full P&L or cost-center accountability for factory operations, including labor, overhead, and capital budgets.
* Deep working knowledge of AS9100, ITAR, DFARS, CMMC, EVMS, and DCMA oversight.
* Hands-on experience implementing automation, robotics, MES, and data-driven process controls with measurable gains in throughput and quality.

Demonstrated leadership experience overseeing procurement, supplier performance, materials management, and production-support functions such as kitting, receiving, shipping, and inventory/storeroom operations.

Experience leading or optimizing manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems (e.g., Costpoint MRP and Purchasing), including cross-functional process and data governance.

* Proven ability to lead and develop large, multi-shift teams, including union or hourly workforces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.
* U.S. citizenship with an active Secret clearance or the ability to obtain one.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* MBA or Master’s degree in Engineering or Operations Management.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt certification.
* Experience standing up a new production facility or greenfield line, and with contract manufacturer and key supplier negotiations.
* Background with prime contractors or fast-growing defense technology companies (e.g., unmanned systems, counter-UAS, C4ISR, or missile systems).

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* All active production programs deliver on schedule, with a clear plan to close any cost or schedule gaps.
* A funded, phased automation roadmap approved by leadership, with early wins in throughput and labor efficiency.
* Factory KPIs (OTD, FPY, OEE, cost per unit, safety) defined, visible, and trending up quarter over quarter.
* A strong leadership bench in place across production, manufacturing engineering, quality, procurement, materials operations, and facilities.
* Facilities and capacity plan aligned to the company’s three-year backlog and growth targets.

Production schedules supported by reliable material planning, supplier performance, inventory accuracy, and effective use of Costpoint MRP/Purchasing or applicable enterprise systems.

**WHY JOIN US**

* **Mission:** Build the systems that protect U.S. service members and critical infrastructure.
* **Impact:** Shape a modern, automated factory and the operating model behind it, with the executive authority and investment to do it.
* **Growth:** Join a growing defense technology company with an expanding backlog of funded programs.
* **Rewards:** Competitive executive compensation, performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits.

*To conform to U.S. Government export regulations (ITAR), applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Advanced Technology Systems Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Join a company where innovation drives growth. At Alloy Precision Technologies, we combine cutting-edge manufacturing, skilled craftsmanship, and a customer-first mindset to deliver industry-leading solutions while providing employees opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

Alloy Precision Technologies

  

**SUMMARY:**

To provide strategic, operational, and day-to-day leadership to the manufacturing operations and manufacturing services function at Alloy Precision Technologies (APT) and to grow the business by increased productivity and profitability within a lean environment. Must be a proven leader who is capable of dealing with sometimes complex and difficult situations.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Leads performance in the planning, coordination, and control of all manufacturing, supply chain, maintenance, production planning, and warehouse functions at APT and the personnel assigned to those functions.
* Establish both quality and efficiency in all production processes to meet performance objectives.
* Promote positive leadership to ensure safety goals and environmental programs for manufacturing operations.
* Direct, monitor, and provide specific feedback on production issues, opportunities, and delays. This will require a proactive approach to investigation and analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution.
* Design and implement on-time tracking systems to monitor manufacturing schedules and operations as necessary to ensure profitability, timely service, and product quality for strong customer service. Provide reports as requested or needed on all aspects of the manufacturing operation.
* Lead the development and implementation of improved operating methods via lean or other strategic manufacturing flow and business process systems and procedures to reduce costs, improve quality performance, and improve profitability.
* Develop effective lines of communication and cooperation between corporate departments and functions within areas of responsibility.
* Promote strong team-building skills. Demonstrate ability to mentor and motivate, as well as to delegate and empower others to succeed.
* Formulate annual operational objectives and programs governing manufacturing, service, and distribution.
* Performs described duties to meet or exceed Customer, AS9100, and regulatory requirements.
* Domestic and international travel may be required.
* Performs other duties assigned by the President and Chief Executive Officer.

  

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Directly supervises group leaders, supply chain, and production planning. Direct reports may be added or subtracted over time.
* Incumbent will carry out supervisory and managerial responsibilities by following APT organizational policies, applicable federal, state, and local laws. Responsibilities include: interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance: rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints, resolving problems, and career development.

  

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* BS in Operations Management, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with 10 plus years of manufacturing management experience. Experience in precision welding (tig, laser, brazing, and soldering), CNC and manual machining, and light assembly operations is a plus.
* Incumbent must have strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications. Experience with computer database systems, Visual Manufacturing, and the development of labor standards for cost structure is a plus. Must have a high level of energy, be results-oriented, confident, and have strong people skills. Must be able to establish and maintain a strong rapport and positive relationships with all levels of staff. Must be strategic in his/her orientation, proactive, persistent, and able to handle multiple projects and customers simultaneously, as well as work within a very fast-paced environment.
* Because the company runs at a very fast pace with multiple, rapidly changing priorities, the incumbent must be highly flexible, resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic organization with an evolving culture. Incumbent must enjoy a challenge, be passionate about his/her work, and commit to excellence and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of lean manufacturing methodologies required, Six Sigma is a plus.

At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

  

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

  
The Senior Director - Plant Manager executes the business strategy focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, and morale of the Camden, South Carolina water heater plant. The Plant Manager will work to continuously improve the organization as well as standardize where possible with other facilities in the appliance business. Additionally, this role collaborates closely with Product Management, Technology, Sourcing, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering and Central Quality to develop and execute NPI (new product introduction) strategies.

**Position**
------------

Senior Director, Plant Management

**Location**
------------

USA, Camden, SC

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

The Senior Director - Plant Manager executes the business strategy focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, and morale of the Camden, South Carolina water heater plant. The Plant Manager will work to continuously improve the organization as well as standardize where possible with other facilities in the appliance business. Additionally, this role collaborates closely with Product Management, Technology, Sourcing, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering and Central Quality to develop and execute NPI (new product introduction) strategies.

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

**Minimum Requirements:**

* BS in either Engineering, Operations Management or Supply Chain
* 15+ years of leadership experience in a Manufacturing environment
* Background and demonstrated technical depth in assembly operations and metal fabrication
* Demonstrated ability to drive change and cultural transformation
* Excellent analytical and complex problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated operational leadership abilities and strong communication/change management skills
* Strong business and financial acumen to include critical daily KPI management
* Demonstrated organizational savvy to work cross-functionally to deliver the desired business results
* Appliance, automotive or consumer goods experience gained in a high volume, short cycle, manufacturing environment
* Strong Lean experience with a history of driving a continuous improvement culture
* Demonstrated ability to work and lead collaboratively in a dynamic environment with both salaried and hourly personnel to deliver business financial objectives, NPI program launches and ultimately meet the needs of our customers

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MS or MBA preferred

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities.  
  
This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices.  
  
By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

protected_roles.description:
Company Overview:

Recognized as a *Milwaukee Journal Sentinel* Top Workplace for 14 consecutive years, including three years of being honored as number one! Join us at West Bend, where we believe that our associates are our greatest asset. We hire talented individuals who are conscientious, dedicated, customer focused, and able to build lasting relationships. We create and maintain an environment where you feel a sense of belonging and appreciation. Your diversity of thought, experience, and knowledge are valued. We’re committed to fostering a welcoming culture, offering you opportunities for meaningful work and professional growth. More than a workplace, we celebrate our successes and take pride in serving our communities.

Job Summary:

The Director Continuous Improvement will establish and mature the enterprise continuous improvement capability, governance framework, and operating model. The Director will enable business divisions to identify, prioritize, implement, and sustain improvements that strengthen efficiency, quality, associate experience, customer experience, and business outcomes.

In partnership with senior executives, functional leaders, and cross-functional teams, the Director will challenge the status quo, redesign workflows, reduce complexity, and build a culture of continuous improvement across the organization. This leader will serve as the head of the Continuous Improvement Center of Excellence (COE), setting enterprise methodology, governance, capability-development, coaching, and portfolio-oversight standards. The Director will partner with business leaders to embed ownership and execution within divisions while maintaining enterprise consistency, transparency, and alignment.

The internal deadline to apply is 11/13/2026. External applications will be accepted on a rolling basis while the position remains open.

**What you will do:**

* Establish and lead the enterprise Continuous Improvement Center of Excellence (COE).
* Develop and maintain the enterprise continuous improvement methodology, standards, tools, templates, and governance framework.
* Lead, coach, and develop direct reports to manage performance and build future leadership capacity.
* Create a culture of accountability, engagement, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* Define and maintain enterprise standards for improvement opportunity identification, prioritization, measurement, and sustainment.
* Assess organizational continuous improvement maturity and develop capability-building roadmaps.
* Facilitate a Community of Practice to share best practices, lessons learned, tools, and success stories across divisions.
* Partner with division leaders to strengthen local ownership and accountability for continuous improvement.
* Provide leadership, coaching, standards, and oversight for the evaluation of current business processes, workflows, handoffs, controls, and decision points to identify inefficiencies, duplication, bottlenecks, risk, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and execute a continuous improvement strategy aligned to the organization’s business priorities, operating model, customer expectations, and transformation goals.
* Establish standards for the use of data, performance metrics, process mapping, root cause analysis, Lean Six Sigma, and other improvement methodologies and coach leaders in their effective application. Challenge existing ways of working in a constructive and collaborative manner, helping leaders and teams move from legacy practices to more effective, scalable, and future-focused processes.
* Lead change management efforts to support adoption of new processes, including stakeholder engagement, communication, training, readiness planning, and reinforcement.
* Establish key performance indicators and reporting mechanisms to measure improvement impact, including efficiency gains, cost savings, cycle time reduction, quality improvement, risk reduction, and experience outcomes.
* Build continuous improvement capability across the organization by coaching leaders, developing practical tools, and creating repeatable methods for process review and redesign.
* Establish and monitor standards for improvement benefit validation, sustainment, and accountability.
* Provide regular reporting and recommendations to executive leadership regarding enterprise improvement performance, capability maturity, and strategic opportunities.
* Create governance and prioritization routines to ensure improvement opportunities are evaluated, sequenced, resourced, and connected to enterprise priorities.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on operational effectiveness, process modernization, and opportunities to simplify work while strengthening execution.

Work Location:

This position offers a hybrid work schedule. Candidates who are located within 50 miles of a West Bend office location will work a hybrid schedule for collaboration days, team meetings or other in-person events. The position can be based in West Bend, WI.

Responsibilities & Qualifications:

**Preferred experience:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in continuous improvement, business transformation, operations, process excellence, organizational effectiveness, or related leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale, cross-functional process improvement initiatives with measurable business impact.
* Knowledge of process improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, value stream mapping, root cause analysis, process mapping, and performance measurement.
* Experience working with senior leaders to evaluate business processes, influence decisions, and drive change across functions.
* Proven ability to translate complex operational challenges into practical, actionable improvement plans.
* Experience in insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry preferred.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, organizational effectiveness, technology, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred.

#LI-SB1

Salary Statement:

The salary range for this position is $157,900 - $197,375  
  
The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity. Compensation decisions are made by West Bend and are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

Benefits:

**West Bend offers a comprehensive benefit plan including** **but not limited to****:**

  

* Medical & Prescription Insurance
* Health Savings Account
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Life and Accidental Death & Disability
* Accident and Critical Illness Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* 401(k) Plan with Company Match
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Time Off. Standard first year PTO is 17 days, pro-rated based on month of hire. Enhanced PTO may be available for experienced candidates
* Bonus eligible based on performance
* West Bend will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act for Colorado employees, in accordance with its plans and policies.

EEO:

West Bend provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. ---------------------

Your morning begins with cross-functional huddles, aligning production, supply chain, maintenance, and planning on the day’s priorities. You review dashboards that track delivery promises, schedule adherence, inventory health, and quality metrics. Midday finds you on the floor diagnosing a throughput constraint, coaching leaders, and reinforcing safe work practices. In the afternoon, you refine the operating rhythm: standard work, real-time schedule visibility, and continuous improvement plans. You close the day mentoring team members and shaping the next wave of operational objectives that sharpen customer service and profitability.

**What you will lead**
----------------------

* End-to-end oversight of manufacturing operations, including production, supply chain, maintenance, production planning, and warehouse activities.
* Deployment of robust quality and efficiency standards that achieve performance targets and elevate product excellence.
* Ownership of safety leadership and environmental stewardship across all operations.
* Proactive resolution of production issues—investigating, analyzing, troubleshooting, and driving timely recovery plans.
* Design and implementation of on-time performance tracking to keep schedules visible and reliable, ensuring strong margins, responsive service, and consistent quality.
* Regular reporting on operational health, highlighting opportunities, risks, and results.
* Implementation of lean manufacturing and other flow/business process systems to reduce cost, improve quality, and increase profitability.
* Stronger cross-functional communication and collaboration with corporate teams and adjacent functions.
* Team building through mentoring, motivation, and effective delegation—empowering leaders to deliver results.
* Annual operating plans and programs that guide manufacturing, service, and distribution performance.
* Execution that meets or exceeds customer commitments and complies with AS9100 and all applicable regulations.
* Domestic and international travel as needed to support operations and customers.

**Supervisory scope**
---------------------

* Direct supervision of group leaders, supply chain, and production planning; scope may evolve as the organization grows.
* Full-cycle people leadership aligned with APT policies and applicable laws: recruiting, hiring, onboarding, training, work assignment, performance evaluation, recognition, corrective action, issue resolution, and career development.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years of manufacturing leadership experience; background in precision welding (TIG, laser, brazing, soldering), CNC/manual machining, and light assembly is advantageous.
* Strong digital fluency: Microsoft Office; experience with databases/ERP (e.g., Visual Manufacturing) and developing labor standards for cost structures is a plus.
* High energy, results orientation, confidence, and strong interpersonal influence; able to build rapport at all levels.
* Strategic, proactive, and persistent; comfortable juggling multiple projects and customers in a fast-paced setting.
* Adaptable and resilient within a dynamic, evolving culture; passionate about excellence and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of lean manufacturing required; Six Sigma experience is a plus.

protected_roles.title: Sourcing Director: NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers
protected_roles.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

The Director, NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers leads strategic execution across new product introduction, acquired-business integration, and supplier/manufacturing transfer initiatives. This senior leader is accountable for ensuring products, processes, supply chains, and teams transition successfully from development, acquisition, or incumbent suppliers into stable, compliant, scalable operations.  
The role requires strong business judgment, deep supply-base knowledge, technical fluency, and the ability to lead complex programs in a regulated medical-device environment. The Director partners closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, R&D, Finance, Manufacturing Engineering, and leadership to deliver continuity of supply, cost competitiveness, product quality, and growth objectives.  
  
Reports to: Senior Director Procurement (Cost Center - M&A)  
Direct reports: Integration Program leaders, supplier-transfer leaders, NPI project managers, supplier development personnel

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

1. NPI Execution and Operational Readiness  

* Lead the end-to-end operational execution of New Product Introduction programs, from design-transfer planning through commercialization and sustained production.
* Establish integrated NPI execution plans & Ensure alignment between product development timelines and operational deliverables, including design transfer, process characterization, validation, supplier readiness, and product availability.
* Drive structured phase-gate governance with external suppliers , program reviews, escalation mechanisms, and executive decision-making for high-priority launches.

  
2. M&A Operations Integration  

* Serve as the Procurement lead for M&A integrations.
* Executes the integration for acquired companies for mitigation of supply-chain risk, supplier dependencies, tier-II management, partners with SQ team for quality-system maturity.
* Define and lead integration roadmaps for acquired businesses, including supplier onboarding, quality-system alignment, tier-II management and smooth transition to Contract manufacturing partner(s)
* Lead Procurement part of integration governance, ensuring milestones, decisions, risks, and accountabilities are visible and managed at the appropriate leadership level.

  
3. Supplier Transfer and Supply-Base Optimization  

* Lead complex supplier-transfer programs, including strategic sourcing transitions, supplier exits, dual-source strategies, vertical-integration initiatives, and manufacturing footprint changes.
* Develop transfer strategies that balance continuity of supply, quality, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, cost, capacity, and timing.
* Ensure supplier transfers are executed in accordance with applicable quality-system requirements, change-control processes, validation requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Direct supplier selection, qualification, technical transfer, process validation, first-article activities, production ramp-up, and supplier performance monitoring.

  
4. People Leadership and Organizational Capability  

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of program, technical, supply-chain, and supplier-management professionals.
* Set clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for direct reports.
* Build succession capability and strengthen organizational depth in NPI execution, technical operations, supplier transfer, and integration management.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration among teams with potentially competing objectives, timelines, and priorities.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

Leadership  

* Builds high-performing teams and develops future leaders.
* Establishes clarity, accountability, and disciplined execution
* Leads through ambiguity, organizational change, and competing business priorities.

Business Acumen  

* Connects technical and operational decisions to financial, customer, and enterprise outcomes.
* Evaluates strategic tradeoffs with an enterprise-wide perspective.
* Identifies opportunities for value creation, risk reduction, and sustainable growth.

Technical and Procurement Expertise  

* Understands manufacturing processes, product industrialization, supplier capabilities, process controls, validation, and quality-system expectations.
* Demonstrates strong command of supply-base dynamics, supplier economics, sourcing strategy, and operational risk.
* Can challenge technical assumptions constructively and facilitate fact-based decisions.

Program Execution  

* Drives complex initiatives from strategy through implementation and stabilization.
* Uses effective governance, metrics, risk management, and escalation practices.
* Maintains focus on customer service, quality, compliance, delivery, and financial results.

Influence and Collaboration  

* Builds credibility with senior leaders, technical experts, plant leadership, suppliers, and all other stakeholders.
* Resolves conflict constructively and aligns diverse stakeholders behind common objectives.
* Communicates complex issues in a concise, actionable manner.

**Your Background**
-------------------

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, or a related technical discipline.
* Approximately 20 years of progressive experience in medical devices, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, or another highly regulated industry.
* Hands on experience & leadership experience in one or more of the following areas:
* New Product Introduction and product industrialization
